subject.title: fix(gateway): generate dashboard titles despite sender metadata

question: Should generated-title retries be allowed to send task content from a failed explicitly configured utility provider/model to the agent primary provider, or should that fallback preserve the configured provider boundary?
rationale: This is an intentional product and data-handling contract choice rather than a mechanical correctness question; the repository policy treats fallbacks and provider/config behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve explicit utility-provider boundaries
options.body: Retry with the primary model only when it remains within the configured utility provider boundary, otherwise retain the current no-title-on-failure behavior.

options.title: Accept cross-provider fallback
options.body: Keep the proposed retry and make the privacy, cost, and provider-routing consequence an explicit documented supported contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve explicit utility-provider boundaries
recommendation.body: Retry with the primary model only when it remains within the configured utility provider boundary, otherwise retain the current no-title-on-failure behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Steipete is the assigned author of the integrated Gateway and utility-model routing change and is the closest available routing candidate.
